title: micromeria microphylla var. villosa
intro: Micromeria microphylla var. villosa, commonly known as Pineapple Mint or Mountain Mint, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This herb has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as aiding digestion, reducing inflammation, and exhibiting antioxidant activity, which can help protect against cell damage and oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Micromeria microphylla var. villosa include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help soothe digestive issues, reduce pain and inflammation, and prevent the growth of microorganisms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
